explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step and is only non-zero at D2: it is high (7-10) at D2 when the previous trial was unrewarded and the agent had been choosing a1 in recent trials, reaching 9-10 after two losses in a row, and it stays high on the first trial after switching from a1 to a2. Otherwise D2 is low: 1-2 during rewarded streaks of a1 choices, 3-4 on the rewarded trial just after a loss, and 0 once the agent has been choosing a2 for a few trials, even if those trials are unrewarded.
